message.reasoning_content:
Oops: `sort -u` sorts lines, not words. Need to split words. Use tr -s ' \n' '\n' then sort -u. So words.txt is wrong. Fix.

Also devnull: Let me redo properly.

function.name: shell
function.arguments:
{"command": "LC_ALL=C tr -s '[:space:]' '\n' < data/b.txt | sed '/^$/d' | LC_ALL=C sort -u > out/words.txt
printf 'sum=%s; unique_words=%s\n' "$(cat out/sum.txt)" "$(wc -l < out/words.txt)" > out/notes.txt
echo "--- sum.txt"; cat out/sum.txt
echo "--- words.txt"; cat -A out/words.txt
echo "--- notes.txt"; cat out/notes.txt"}
